Lower Treasury yields leave Bitcoin's demand question open
Why it matters: On November 4, the U.S. Department of the Treasury's nominal 10-year par yield was 4.90%, down from 4.95% on November 3.
Context: On November 4, the U.S. Department of the Treasury's nominal 10-year par yield was 4.90%, down from 4.95% on November 3. For Bitcoin, the useful distinction is between a lower return on an interest-bearing alternative and evidence that investors want more exposure to a volatile asset.
